latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of AI Editor for Instagram.
- Upload and edit videos (up to 500MB, MP4/MOV/AVI/WebM), with server-side rendering at 1080p.
- Supports Instagram-oriented workflows: easy export for Reels/Stories, text overlays, transitions, and background music.
- Automatic session handling: uses NEMO_TOKEN or acquires a free temporary token.
- Clear connection status and error handling, keeping technical details hidden from users.
- All interactions handled in a session; export/download ready within 30–90 seconds per edit.
